rationale: The classifier step is correctly specified: glmnet penalized logistic regression with nested cross-validation, feature selection inside each outer fold, out-of-fold ROC-AUC with a bootstrap or DeLong CI, per-fold panel stability, and an explicit statement that the estimate is internal and needs an external cohort; the leukocyte-composition confound caveat is a genuine strength. It falls short of the reference in not stating stratified outer folds, not refitting a final model on all 120 samples with coefficients and selection frequencies, and leaving filterByExpr (group-aware) and TMM scaling fitted on all samples outside the folds, and it omits balanced accuracy or Brier. QC is thorough with named-not-dropped outlier policy, and the filter, TMM, design and BH threshold are all explicit. The DE and Hallmark/Reactome enrichment steps are well specified (moderated-t ranking, tested-gene universe, versioned collections, 15-500 window) but are not warranted by a classifier question, and the justification that NB models inflate false positives at n>=50 is contestable; the report covers versions, seeds, design, counts and the internal-estimate caveat but does not explicitly warn that a depth or batch signal aligned with class would inflate the AUC.
